summary: The thread discusses adding a new HLL blob type to the Puffin spec to improve NDV statistics performance. The proposal introduces apache-datasketches-hll-v1, but raises questions about handling tables that mix Theta and HLL blobs and whether readers can merge them. The discussion centers on whether to keep reading statistics for non-equality columns in equality delete files, as these stats can cause incorrect pruning and leave undeleted rows. The discussion concluded that the X-Iceberg-Access-Delegation header should include a new enum value, "none", to indicate that the client does not require delegated access from the catalog.
